span.span: A mel spectrogram, audio as energy per frequency band over time, with bands spaced to follow human pitch perception. Ours has 128 bands and 93.75 frames per second. Real mels come from the teacher’s audio, generated mels from the acoustic model.
Computing a mel from existing audio, here the teacher’s, and passing it through the vocoder alone. It shows what the vocoder loses by itself.
The teacher, unmodified VoxCPM2, generated all training audio. The student, Antalia-2 Mini, trained on its clips.
Training clips of sentences up to about 25 s, and of short utterances, mostly fragments of 2 to 6 words.

One render of all 495 benchmark sentences.
Our test setup for Freya-TR-Eval with public code: 3 takes, seed 100000
, one NVIDIA L4 each for Mini and EMA Lightning (different VMs).

Our second setup, with the same scoring and private code: 3 takes, each with one seed for all its sentences (seeds 0, 1, 2). Mini 1.0.1 ran them on an L40S, an A10G and an A100, EMA Lightning on an H200, and the teacher 1 seed on an A100.
Audio is resampled down to 8 kHz and back up to 16 kHz before Whisper hears it, as the benchmark’s card recommends.

Word and character error rate: word or character edit distance between Whisper’s transcript and the reference, over reference length, in percent. On the benchmark, Whisper (large-v3, beam 5) hears band-matched audio and each take gets one score.
Percentage points, our unit for differences: 1.09% against 1.04% is 0.05 points.
The paired 95% interval of a difference includes 0. Figures also say not separable or within noise. “Level with” is a stricter test (Section
0.13 WER points, the standard deviation across Mini 1.0.0’s 3 own-harness seeds. The
The share of sentences with no word error in a take, averaged over takes.

UTMOS22-strong, an automatic estimate of the mean opinion score (MOS), the average rating listeners give, trained on English speech; higher is better. For scale, the teacher scores 3.42 on the benchmark (full band, own harness, 1 seed). It runs on 16 kHz audio, so neither UTMOS nor WER hears anything above 8 kHz. Full-band UTMOS skips band matching and 8 kHz UTMOS includes it.
Real-time factor is wall-clock synthesis time over audio duration. Times real time is its inverse, so RTF 0.024 is 41×.
